system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Lambda function backing the API
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-api-health-dashboard
Resources:
  LambdaHealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "AWS/Lambda", "Invocations", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "period": 300 } ]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Invocations (Sum)",
                "period": 300
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "AWS/Lambda", "Errors", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "period": 300 } ]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Errors (Sum)",
                "period": 300
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "AWS/Lambda", "Throttles", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Sum", "period": 300 } ]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Throttles (Sum)",
                "period": 300
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "metrics": [
                  [ "AWS/Lambda", "Duration", "FunctionName", "${LambdaFunctionName}", { "stat": "Average", "period": 300 } ]
                ],
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Duration (Average ms)",
                "period": 300
              }
            }
          ]
        }
